bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
head_sha=b1b42b586376a9c598756b8b42cf58a27aa39688
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo CREATOR_PIN_SOURCE_FETCH_FAILED; exit 66; }
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$head_sha" || { echo CREATOR_PIN_SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH; exit 67; }
d="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-create-pin.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
git archive "$head_sha" | tar -xf - -C "$d"
test -f "$d/src/runtime/creatorStickerPinMain.mjs" || { echo CREATOR_PIN_SOURCE_NOT_STAGED; exit 68; }
candidates=()
for f in "$PWD"/deploy/secrets/* "$PWD"/deploy/*token* "$HOME"/.config/create-videobot/*; do
 test -f "$f" || continue
 case "$(basename "$f" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" in *userbot*|*session*|*oauth*|*phone*) continue;; esac
 case "$(basename "$f" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" in *bot*|*token*|*secret*) :;; *) continue;; esac
 size="$(stat -c %s "$f")"
 mode="$(stat -c %a "$f")"
 test "$size" -ge 35 && test "$size" -le 512 && test "$mode" = 600 || continue
 candidates+=("$f")
done
test "${#candidates[@]}" -eq 1 || { echo CREATOR_PIN_PRIVATE_CREDENTIAL_NOT_UNIQUE; exit 69; }
state="$HOME/.local/state/create-videobot/sticker-entry"
mkdir -p "$state";chmod 700 "$state"
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="${candidates[0]}"
export VIDEOBOT_STICKER_PIN_STATE_SOURCE="$state"
output="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-create-pin-log.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$d";rm -f "$output"' EXIT
if docker compose -f "$d/deploy/compose.videobot.topic-pin.yaml" run --build --rm videobot-topic-pin >"$output" 2>&1; then
 grep -E '^CREATOR_STICKER_PIN_(API_ACK|MESSAGE_ID|PREEXISTING)=' "$output" || true
 grep -qx 'CREATOR_STICKER_PIN_API_ACK=PASS' "$output" || { echo CREATOR_PIN_ACK_NOT_RETURNED; exit 70; }
 echo CREATOR_OWNER_TELEGRAM_PIN=PASS
else
 grep -E '^CREATOR_[A-Z0-9_]+$' "$output" | tail -n 5 || true
 echo CREATOR_OWNER_PIN_RUN_FAILED
 exit 71
fi
